title: Derwin James agrees to three-year, $75.6 million extension

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Derwin James agrees to three-year, $75.6 million extension
sources.description: Chargers General Manager Joe Hortiz said last week that keeping safety Derwin James in the organization for his entire career was a high priority and that became a likelier outcome on Tuesday.
